Last week’s shooting at Tiger Shroff triggered fear and questions about the Bollywood-underworld nexus and whether the era of lawlessness seen in the 90s is threatening to return to Mumbai. In this episode, Sonikka Loganathan speaks to The Hindu’s Maharashtra Bureau Chief, Vinaya Deshpande, about what who Lawrence Bishnoi is, what his gang’s motive and aim is, the history of organised crime in Bollywood and how the Bishnoi gang differs from the likes of Dawood Ibrahim and Haji Mastan.
